name: STAC Machine Learning Model Extension Ontology
title: Definitions for STAC MLM extension elements
description: Vocabulary defining the elements of the STAC Machine Learning Model (MLM) extension, including model identity, input/output structures, band and variable references, value scaling, and model assets. The ontology documents interactions with STAC core, EO, Raster, Datacube, Classification, Processing, Application, and VCS extensions. Input/output descriptions use the distinct mlm:io_description predicate.
